question.text: Which section of SCRA excludes spot contracts from the requirement of obtaining consent when a member enters into a contract as a principal?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 18 of SCRA specifically excludes spot contracts from the Section 15 requirement of securing consent when a member enters into a contract as a principal. The Trap: Section 15 is tempting because it deals with member-as-principal contracts, but it is Section 18 that carves out the exclusion for spot delivery contracts. Note: Pair Section 15 (consent requirement) with Section 18 (spot-contract exclusion) when reading SCRA on member-as-principal dealings.
